purpose: Research assistance for manual review of English news, not autonomous truth adjudication.
primary_kpi: Macro-F1 with bootstrap interval on independent raw headlines; report full-text ISOT separately.

partitions.train: Original chronological train, excluding evaluation labels.
partitions.tuning: First 40 percent of original validation dates/rows.
partitions.internal_reused_test: Old test already observed in v1; diagnostic, not a new confirmatory test.
partitions.external: Pinned FakeNewsNet raw CSV titles, evaluated only after candidate and policy are frozen.

feature_rule: Remove predeclared publisher/contact/byline/social boilerplate. ANOVA and SHAP are diagnostics, never independent validation or a rule that high importance is bad.
calibration: Member Platt calibrators and fusion Platt calibrator fit on separate chronological subsets.
external_unit: Headline only. No tweet hydration or publisher scraping. Compare with ISOT headline-only diagnostic.
external_reuse_rule: Never tune on external labels. A failed release gate remains failed; future tuning requires a new independent external set.

negative_controls.selection_fit: ANOVA selector refitted for every shuffled training-label vector.

legal_scope_assumption: Local noncommercial academic research in Moldova; no redistribution/public deployment clearance asserted.

english_improvement.purpose: Reduce false accusations of real English news, improve balanced classification, preserve manual-review release gate.
english_improvement.eligible_data: Only ISOT/WELFake article-level labels. Existing held-out validation/test/external groups remain excluded from fitting. Publisher proxies, health quality ratings and claim scales are not binary article labels.
english_improvement.split: Union exact normalized headlines with existing near-body groups, quarantine label conflicts, reserve prior held-out groups, then stratified group allocation by class and source with seed 42.
english_improvement.views: Full lead plus title or short lead augmentation; all views of an article stay in one role and share its training weight. Separate short/full member and fusion calibration.
english_improvement.selection: Best mean short/full tuning macro-F1 per family; no external outcomes select candidates. Threshold maximizes policy macro-F1 under false-real-accusation rate <= 0.20 when feasible; tie favors fewer false accusations. Review boundaries retain per-class precision constraints.
english_improvement.external_rule: Only text is opened before fitting for label-blind overlap exclusion. External labels are opened once after candidate and thresholds are frozen. FakeNewsNet is a reused diagnostic and cannot select the model.
english_improvement.external_kpi: Macro-F1, real-to-fake false positive rate, fake recall, confusion matrix; FakeNewsAMT and Celebrity reported separately. Bootstrap entire paired news groups, not individual counterfactual variants.
english_improvement.robustness: Original, uppercase, publisher prefix, social footer, typos and headline-only on internal held-out groups. Training-only ANOVA and permuted-label controls; component SHAP explicitly distinct from final consensus.
english_improvement.release: Automatic user verdicts remain disabled; changing model parameters does not establish factual verification or redistribution rights. Replace only the current canonical model after evaluation; create no version folders or model copies in the project.

refinement.purpose: Reduce false accusations with format-matched calibration and regularized stacking. English only; no autonomous factual verdicts.
refinement.frozen_base: Vocabulary, IDF, feature weights and all three base estimators remain fixed.
refinement.member_calibration: Separate Platt fits on calibration_members for each format.
refinement.selection: Per format, maximize mean tuning macro-F1 minus 0.05 times tuning real-to-fake rate. Ties favor current model, then stronger regularization. Calibration_fusion fits the combining model; policy never selects fusion parameters.
refinement.threshold: Choose on policy only: retain macro-F1 within 0.015 of its optimum and recall >= 0.70, prefer real-to-fake rate <=0.10 (else <=0.20), minimize 5*false_fake + false_real. No external-driven retuning.
refinement.adoption: Adopt selected calibration/stacking only if mean format tuning macro-F1 is no more than 0.005 below current and mean format tuning false_fake_rate does not increase after locked policy thresholds. Otherwise keep current model and record the rejected experiment.
refinement.confirmation: unused_capacity groups have not been used by base model or scored before this refinement; evaluate after freeze as a new within-corpus confirmation only. internal_group_test and all FakeNewsAMT, Celebrity and FakeNewsNet results are explicitly reused diagnostics.
refinement.artifacts: Replace existing model and training report in place. No version directories or copies of project documents.

validation_followup.reason: Joint conservative-threshold experiment was rejected on tuning only, before confirmation or external scoring. Short-format macro-F1 loss exceeded the original adoption budget.
validation_followup.per_format_protection: Retain current format rule when the candidate tuning macro-F1 is more than 0.005 below current or its false-fake rate increases. No external results are used.
validation_followup.confirmation_status: unused_capacity and external data have not been scored for the rejected candidate.
